about: Spawns whose creature the core picks when it spawns them: the world stores one entry on the spot and a script returns one of several (InstanceScript::GetCreatureEntry). The spawn audit counts such a row as a spot of each of them (tools/ft/spawncount.py picked()). One line per stored entry and map; 'source' says where the core does it.

picks.name: Blackwing Lair: Corrupted Red, Green, Blue and Bronze Whelp
